Final-assistant Omi mark ownership and canonical expandable tool-call presentation are row-level rendering contracts that belong with bubble equality and layout. The mark remains an overlay so it cannot shift bubbles horizontally, while its owner row reserves the mark's height to prevent an empty streaming reply from clipping at the transcript live edge.

Canonical Memory Atlas routing, unified Memory navigation, the cohort-not-yet-known guard, and leave handling coexist in the home content owner; the combined SwiftUI expression is split into independently type-checkable helper properties, with a further component split tracked separately.

Home ask bar now auto-grows as a multi-line TextField so long messages wrap instead of scrolling off-screen; the Home prompt rail also receives the ask bar's outer trailing edge so the custom rail aligns flush with it; a component split is tracked follow-up.

It is already separate from the atlas view — a further split of detection from simulation is tracked follow-up.
